settings.title: Network features
settings.lead: The network serves the essentials from day one: post, comment, react, share, talk in iCom. The modules below stay closed until the network administration opens them. Each opening and each closing is justified and recorded in the engine's decision log; closing deletes no data.
settings.restricted: Network features are reserved for the network administration.

sheet.openDescription: The feature will appear for every member of the network, and the engine will serve its pages.
sheet.closeDescription: The feature will disappear for every member of the network, and the engine will refuse its pages. The data stays: reopening brings it back.

errors.network_feature_requires_parent: This feature lives on pages: open associations and businesses first.
errors.network_feature_has_open_children: A feature that lives on pages is still open (groups and events, services or jobs): close it first.
errors.network_feature_reason_length: The reason must be between {{min}} and {{max}} characters long.
